claim: Northgate Branch announced Sunday opening and later Saturday closing from 6 April.
verbatim_excerpt: Northgate Branch will open on Sundays from 6 April, 11:00 to 16:00, and will close at 17:00 on Saturdays instead of 13:00.

claim: Northgate counted 1,880 weekend visits in June, against 1,410 in June the year before.
verbatim_excerpt: Northgate Branch counted 1,880 weekend visits in June, against 1,410 in June last year

claim: The Northgate comparison covers one month only.
verbatim_excerpt: The figures cover one month only.

claim: Millbrook Branch announced it would stay open until 18:00 on Saturdays, up from 13:00, from 31 May.
verbatim_excerpt: From 31 May, Millbrook Branch will stay open until 18:00 on Saturdays, up from 13:00.

claim: Millbrook's weekend visits were nearly flat after its Saturday hours were extended: about 960 a month against 940 a year earlier.
verbatim_excerpt: Millbrook Branch reports about 960 weekend visits a month, close to the 940 a month it recorded over the same months last year

claim: Linden Street, whose weekend hours did not change, recorded 1,020 weekend visits in September against 1,000 a year earlier.
verbatim_excerpt: Linden Street Branch, whose weekend hours did not change this year, recorded 1,020 weekend visits in September against 1,000 in September last year.

claim: The district reports that weekend visits rose across all branches this year, without giving figures.
verbatim_excerpt: The district's annual report says weekend visits across all branches rose this year. The report gives no figures for weekend visits and does not break them down by branch.

claim: Northgate's weekend visits rose to 1,880 in June from 1,410 a year earlier.
verbatim_excerpt: Weekend visits at Northgate Branch rose to 1,880 in June from 1,410 a year earlier

claim: Northgate counted 1,980 weekend visits in June.
verbatim_excerpt: Northgate Branch counted 1,980 weekend visits in June

claim: Staff at Millbrook said the extra Saturday evening hours were mostly quiet.
verbatim_excerpt: Staff said the extra evening hours were mostly quiet.
